Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting discrimination against licensed health care providers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting discrimination against licensedhealth care providers; and adding a new section to chapter 48.30 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.30 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A person or entity engaged in the business of insurance in thisstate may not unfairly discriminate against providers licensed underchapter 18.53 RCW.
